import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3to1=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"))
def parse(path, chain=None, lo=None, hi=None, heavy_only=True):
    out=[]
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if not line.startswith('ATOM'): continue
        if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        if chain and line[21]!=chain: continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3to1: continue
        el=(line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
        if heavy_only and el=='H': continue
        r=int(line[22:26])
        if lo is not None and (r<lo or r>hi): continue
        out.append((line[12:16].strip(),rn,line[21],r,
                    np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])))
    return out
def bb(atoms,chain,s,e):
    o=[]
    for r in range(s,e+1):
        d={a[0]:a[4] for a in atoms if a[3]==r and a[2]==chain}
        if not all(k in d for k in ('N','CA','C','O')): return None
        o+=[d['N'],d['CA'],d['C'],d['O']]
    return np.array(o)
def kabsch_apply(P,Q,X):
    pm,qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd((P-pm).T@(Q-qm)); U=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W))])@W
    return (X-pm)@U+qm, float(np.sqrt((((P-pm)@U-(Q-qm))**2).sum()/len(P)))
tryp=parse('work/2PTC.pdb','E'); bpti=parse('work/2PTC.pdb','I')
TR=np.array([a[4] for a in tryp]); tmpl=bb(bpti,'I',13,18)
def dock(path,chain,resids,label,lo=None,hi=None):
    atoms=parse(path,chain,lo,hi); X=np.array([a[4] for a in atoms])
    ch=chain or atoms[0][2]; rows=[]
    for r in resids:
        f=bb(atoms,ch,r-2,r+3)
        if f is None: continue
        Xt,rms=kabsch_apply(f,tmpl,X)
        mind=np.linalg.norm(Xt[:,None,:]-TR[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
        rows.append(dict(protein=label,P1=f'{AA3to1[[a for a in atoms if a[3]==r][0][1]]}{r}',
            loop_fit_RMSD=round(rms,2),clash_lt2_5A=int((mind<2.5).sum()),clash_lt3A=int((mind<3.0).sum()),
            heavy_atoms=len(X)))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
parts=[dock('work/2PTC.pdb','I',[15],'BPTI in native trypsin complex'),
       dock('work/5PTI.pdb','A',[15],'BPTI free crystal form'),
       dock('work/1TGS.pdb','I',[18],'PSTI (Kazal fold, independent)'),
       dock('work/1CHO.pdb','I',[18],'OMTKY3 (Kazal fold, independent)'),
       dock('work/1EAW.pdb','B',[15],'APP Kunitz domain'),
       dock('work/PI15_human.pdb',None,[131,133,202,128,164,224,80],'PI15 mature',61,258)]
dk=pd.concat(parts,ignore_index=True)
pd.set_option('display.width',240); print(dk.to_string(index=False))
dk.to_csv('work/pi15_trypsin_dock_clash.csv',index=False)

# theoretical pI / net charge of mature PI15 vs canonical inhibitors
SEQ='MIAISAVSSALLFSLLCEASTVVLLNSTDSSPPTNNFTDIEAALKAQLDSADIPKARRKRYISQNDMIAILDYHNQVRGKVFPPAANMEYMVWDENLAKSAEAWAATCIWDHGPSYLLRFLGQNLSVRTGRYRSILQLVKPWYDEVKDYAFPYPQDCNPRCPMRCFGPMCTHYTQMVWATSNRIGCAIHTCQNMNVWGSVWRRAVYLVCNYAPKGNWIGEAPYKVGVPCSSCPPSYGGSCTDNLCFPGVTSNYLYWFK'
def charge(s,pH=7.4):
    pk={'D':3.65,'E':4.25,'C':8.37,'Y':10.46,'H':6.0,'K':10.53,'R':12.48}
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-8.0))-1/(1+10**(3.65-pH))
    for a in s:
        if a in 'KRH': q+= 1/(1+10**(pH-pk[a]))
        elif a in 'DECY': q-= 1/(1+10**(pk[a]-pH))
    return q
def pI(s):
    lo,hi=2.,13.
    for _ in range(60):
        m=(lo+hi)/2
        if charge(s,m)>0: lo=m
        else: hi=m
    return (lo+hi)/2
mat=SEQ[60:]
print(f'\nMature PI15 (61-258): length {len(mat)}, net charge at pH 7.4 = {charge(mat):+.1f}, theoretical pI = {pI(mat):.2f}')
print(f'Propeptide 20-60: net charge {charge(SEQ[19:60]):+.1f} (contains the furin-type RRKR at 56-59)')
print('Trypsin is a basic enzyme (pI ~10.5); an acidic ligand favours non-specific retention on trypsin-Sepharose.')

colors=['#2ca02c' if 'BPTI' in p or 'Kazal' in p or 'Kunitz' in p else '#d62728' for p in dk.protein]
lbl=[f'{p.split("(")[0].strip()}\n{q}' for p,q in zip(dk.protein,dk.P1)]

ax.set_ylabel('heavy atoms within 2.5 A of trypsin')
ax.set_title('Canonical engagement of trypsin is sterically impossible for PI15.\nEach protein is placed by superposing its candidate P1 loop\non the BPTI reactive-site loop of the 2PTC trypsin complex.',fontsize=9,loc='left')

ax=axes[1]

for _,r in dk.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r.P1,(r.loop_fit_RMSD,r.clash_lt2_5A),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,2),textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_xlabel("RMSD of the P3-P3' loop to the BPTI canonical loop (A)")
ax.set_ylabel('heavy atoms within 2.5 A of trypsin')
ax.set_title('Independent inhibitor folds (green) reach the canonical pose with\nalmost no clashes; every PI15 arginine or lysine (red) buries\nthe CAP body inside the enzyme.',fontsize=9,loc='left')
